# prakriti-growth-measurement-engine

**Prakriti Foods is a fictional company created for an independent student portfolio project. All company data is synthetic, generated by the author and calibrated to publicly reported benchmarks for Indian D2C brands (sources cited). No real company's data was used. Results demonstrate a method and are not claims about any real brand.**

Status: Phases 0-5 complete. Next: Phase 6 (open the sealed truth, grade MMM v1/v1b/v2 and OLS, then optimise).
- Phase 1: stage-1 data generated, truth sealed, hash in `sealed/HASH.txt` (committed before any modelling).
- Phase 2: attribution audit (notebook 01 + SQL), exploration and VIF (notebook 02 part A), OLS baseline (notebook 07), MMM v1 (FAILED diagnostics, kept as documented first attempt) and MMM v1b (passes diagnostics, wide ROI intervals; see notebook 02 parts B-C).

Layout: `data/generated` (stage-1 files), `sealed/HASH.txt` (SHA-256 of truth.json; truth itself is NOT in this repo until Phase 6), `notebooks/generate_data.py` (generator), `notebooks/calibration_check.py` (reads data files only).

AI-assistance note: code and drafting were produced with Claude; every result reported must come from code run by the author.

- Phase 3: geo-experiment design and pre-registration (`notebooks/03_geo_experiment.ipynb`, `preregistration/design.md`, `design.json`).
- Phase 4: stage-2 data (weeks 88-104) generated under the committed pre-registration; continuity with stage 1 verified (`data/continuity_check.txt`); readout in `notebooks/03_geo_experiment.ipynb` part B. `data/generated` = stage 1 (weeks 1-87, as committed in Phase 2); `data/stage2` = full 104 weeks plus `cro_sessions.csv`.
- Phase 5: MMM v2 calibrated with the geo experiment (`notebooks/02_mmm.ipynb` part D, `mmm_v2_fit.py`); cohort survival and CLV by channel (`05_cohort_clv.ipynb`, `clv_fit.py`, `clv_run.py`); checkout A/B test with peeking simulation (`06_cro_experiment.ipynb`). MMM v2 has 4 divergences (partial pass); CAC figures are relative only (see notebook 05).
